# pptx test fixtures

`01_standard_business.pptx` and `05_unicode_cjk_emoji.pptx` were generated
with [python-pptx](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx) (MIT License,
copyright Steve Canny) and derive their slide master / layouts / theme from
python-pptx's built-in default template. The MIT permission notice those
parts are distributed under is in `LICENSE-python-pptx.txt` next to this
file. Slide text content is synthetic test data authored for this repository.
